verdict: The curriculum has strong discovery-task coverage and mostly executable probes, but its hierarchy and prerequisite graph need revision before the sections can support stable sampling or evaluation.
findings: Coverage: The 17 sections cover all six C03 guideposts and give a direct home to each discovery task: unix-001 maps to shell state, unix-002 to package selection, unix-003 to file transforms, unix-004 to service operation, unix-005 to process coordination, unix-006 to route resolution, unix-007 to runtime context, and unix-008 to stream and log diagnosis. Security administration beyond file access and delegated commands, plus process resource diagnosis such as CPU or memory pressure, has weaker outcome and probe coverage.

Observable outcomes: Every section uses an action and a result that can be checked. The leaf outcomes usually identify a correctness condition, such as preserved record boundaries, verified route choice, effective access, or a tested restore. The broad root outcomes are less predictive because they combine several child outcomes instead of defining one coherent performance target.

Boundaries: Most leaf includes and excludes separate adjacent work well. Two boundaries remain unstable. c03.shell-workflows includes redirection and uses an output-capture diagnosis as a probe, which overlaps c03.stream-log-diagnosis. c03.network-access places local users, file modes, ACLs, and sudo-style delegation under network reachability even though those tasks require no network path.

Learnable progression: The two-level hierarchy is easy to follow, but c03.identity-permissions does not refine the network-oriented claim of its parent. Several prerequisite edges state useful background as a hard dependency: timezone and clock work in c03.runtime-context does not require shell-state mastery, backup design does not require resizing or repairing filesystems, and basic service configuration does not require the full process-coordination and stream-ordering outcomes.

Useful granularity: The leaves generally support varied tasks while retaining a shared correctness contract. c03.runtime-context spans environment inheritance, locale, timezone, and clock synchronization, so success on a one-command locale task predicts little about host clock administration. The root sections are broad unions of their children and would be poor standalone sampling units unless generation is restricted to leaves.

Generation probe: Each section has two concrete instructions, and every pair differs in substance. The strongest leaf pairs test distinct cases, such as package selection versus transaction preview and backup planning versus staged restoration. Several root probes merely select one task from each child distribution, while the first c03.process-service-observation probe combines interrupted timing with split output streams; these probes do not establish a distinct root-level capability.

Mapping: No held-out mapping results were supplied. The redirection overlap between c03.shell-workflows and c03.stream-log-diagnosis is a specific likely ambiguity, while the eight discovery tasks otherwise have clear leaf destinations.

Size: Five roots and twelve leaves at depth two are manageable for the six guideposts and the extra routing evidence. If all 17 sections are sampled, the five aggregate roots duplicate leaf distributions and add avoidable weighting. Treating roots as organization-only nodes or removing redundant roots would make the effective curriculum smaller without losing leaf coverage.
rubric_changes: Specify whether internal hierarchy nodes are generation and evaluation targets. If they are, require a distinct task distribution at each internal node; if they are organization-only nodes, exclude their probes from generation and size judgments.
